subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should `codexbar cookie refresh` be accepted when an entitlement-limited CLI cannot complete browser import itself, or must the command fail without mutation unless it can prove a replacement cookie was imported?
rationale: The command’s intended user contract is a direct refresh, while the submitted description still documents a cache-clear-plus-later-app-reimport fallback; choosing between those contracts affects user expectations and credential-cache safety.

options.title: Require verified replacement
options.body: Keep existing cache state on import failure and merge only once the command demonstrates replacement through the supported signed/import-capable path.

options.title: Accept deferred re-import
options.body: Allow a clearly reported pending-reimport outcome after cache clearing, with documentation that a later app refresh—not the CLI—completes the operation.

recommendation.title: Require verified replacement
recommendation.body: Keep existing cache state on import failure and merge only once the command demonstrates replacement through the supported signed/import-capable path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows steipete carrying the implementation and its credential-cache safety follow-ups.
